verdict.rationale: Browser Use is API-first. The docs show programmatic control of the core workflow: creating agent runs, reusing sessions across runs, launching and stopping cloud browsers with CDP access, polling events to build a custom UI, getting the live_view_url for human checkpoints, and an official MCP server. However, nothing explicitly claims or demonstrates that every UI/dashboard action has an API equivalent, and no OpenAPI spec was found to verify coverage. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, a published OpenAPI spec, documented API coverage for profile creation/management and account or billing actions, and independent corroboration of parity.
